list.name: channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel_name AS __text, channel_id AS __value FROM app_metrics WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95 FROM app_latency WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, channel_name AS metric, avg(bitrate) AS bitrate FROM app_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, channel_name AS metric, avg(fps) AS fps FROM app_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, channel_name || ' health' AS metric, avg(health_score) AS v FROM app_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, channel_name || ' buffer' AS metric, avg(buffer_health) AS v FROM app_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, channel_name AS metric, max(viewer_count) AS viewers FROM app_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
